name: mame01
title: MAME 0.1 (DJGPP + Allegro, 1997-02-05)
_units: The core, the Z80, four drivers, and MAME's OWN platform backend -- src/msdos/msdos.c, the file its makefile selects for DOS. That file used to be replaced by a JavaScript one; what is shimmed now is the two libraries it links, which is the whole difference between porting a program and running it.
_include: The tree is not flat and its makefile passes -Isrc -Isrc/Z80 -Isrc/msdos.
_defines: LSB_FIRST, and deliberately NOT X86_ASM: that macro selects the x86 assembly path, which is the same choice as Quake's id386=0.
